units.text: Choose the S three import or export feature for your Aurora engine. MySQL can load data from S three and export eligible query results with SELECT INTO OUTFILE S three. PostgreSQL uses the aws_s3 extension for supported imports and exports.

Check engine and version support, the database user's privileges, and the cluster I A M role, bucket permissions, key permissions where needed, and network access. Test with a small file and verify the results. Moving data this way is not a transactional backup.

An RDS event tells you what changed, not whether the database is healthy. Subscribe to relevant categories, such as failover, and deliver them to SNS. Test the supported subscriber and permissions. Then correlate the event with CloudWatch metrics and engine logs. If a failover notice arrives, verify the current writer and test an application connection; notifications can be delayed.

A container image packages code and user-space dependencies. A container is the process running from that image on a compatible host; it does not bring a whole virtual machine's kernel. Match CPU architecture and operating-system family, and set resource limits. When a container can be replaced, keep durable data outside its writable layer. Choose shared files, attached blocks on supported configurations, or object storage by how the application uses the data.

Choose which API manages the deployment before deciding who manages the capacity. ECS supplies A W S-native tasks and services; EKS supplies the Kubernetes API and ecosystem. E C two gives you host and capacity control. Fargate runs supported tasks or pods without customer-managed workers. You still own application health, images, permissions and networking. For example, choose ECS for the A W S task model, then consider Fargate if the team does not need host-level control.

The task definition describes the container workload; a task is one running instance of that definition. In the cluster shown, the service maintains two healthy tasks and replaces an unhealthy copy. The cluster groups the work and its available capacity. A standalone task handles a finite batch job; ECS does not maintain a desired count after it exits.

Read the task definition as a versioned deployment contract. Specify the image and platform, CPU and memory, ports, logging, and references to secrets and storage. With Fargate, choose a supported CPU and memory combination and ensure the app really listens on its declared port. Register a new revision for changes to that definition, then deploy it; editing a draft does not update running tasks.

Use the task role for what the running application does, such as reading S three or writing DynamoDB. The execution role authorizes configured startup operations, such as image pulls, logs and injected secrets. The E C two instance profile is for the container host agent in the E C two launch type. Keep these jobs separate. A task role does not make a shared host a hard isolation boundary.

Follow traffic from the load balancer to the real target. In the E C two bridge example, register the instance and the mapped host port, not the container port by itself. With A W S VPC networking, including Fargate, choose IP targets and reach the task network interface at its port. Permit the traffic and health-check path. Pick ALB for HTTP routing or NLB when the requirement is layer-four routing.

The modes change which address the task uses. None has no external network connection. Bridge runs containers behind the host's port mapping. Host mode shares the instance network and has port conflicts if multiple tasks need the same host port. A W S VPC mode assigns the task an interface and security group; Fargate requires it. Plan subnet IP capacity, and check platform support.

A private Fargate task still needs service connectivity. For this endpoint-only ECR path, use the ECR API and registry endpoints and the S three gateway endpoint for image layers. Add access to CloudWatch Logs and Secrets Manager when the task uses them. NAT can provide needed outbound access in another design; both patterns can coexist for different traffic. If startup fails, check DNS, routes, security groups, endpoint policies and execution-role permissions separately.

Secrets Manager or Parameter Store can supply a secret at startup without baking it into the image. When the stored value changes, the running task's environment does not refresh. Start a replacement task or force a new deployment as appropriate. If the app must retrieve fresh values at runtime, use its task role and a deliberate refresh policy. Never log the secret.

An ECS service keeps a continuous API at its desired number of healthy tasks behind the load balancer. For a finite job, use a standalone task; EventBridge Scheduler can invoke RunTask at the chosen time. A schedule is not proof of job completion. Collect exit status and logs, make retries safe, and keep shared application state outside replaceable tasks.
